interpretation.timestamp_writes: Range-based monotonically increasing timestamps route the newest inserts to the chunk that owns the latest time range. Actual owning shard and counts are measured below.
interpretation.hashed_user_writes: Hashed customer/user keys distribute distinct user values across hash ranges. Actual chunk ownership and counts are measured below.
interpretation.measurement_note: Counts and plans are read from the running cluster. Distribution is not asserted to a predetermined ratio.
